title: Maybe Slowly, Maybe Imperfectly
script_text:
I'm proud of you, for not giving up on yourself.
Even when you were disappointed.
Even when you felt behind.
Even when you looked around and thought everyone else was doing better.
You kept going.
Maybe slowly, maybe imperfectly.
But you kept going.
And I'll always admire you for that.

title: We'll Both Have Bad Days
script_text:
I love you, but I know we'll both have bad days.
Days when you're irritated.
Days when I'm tired.
Days when we take things personally that weren't meant that way.
But even then, one bad day won't change what you mean to me.
Through every hard day we go through, you'll have me and I'll have you.

title: I Don't Want To Keep Score
script_text:
I love you, and I don't want us to keep score.
Who was irritated first, who did more, who was right, who made the last mistake.
I don't want to win against you.
I want us to get through things together.
Because no matter what we're going through, it will always be us, me and you.

title: So Much Further Than Where You Started
script_text:
I'm proud of you.
Because I remember when this used to feel impossible.
When you doubted yourself.
When you didn't know if you could do it.
And now look at you.
Maybe you're still not where you want to be.
But you're so much further than where you started.
Every step brought you here.
And I'm so proud of you.

title: Why I Do Too
script_text:
I love seeing you being loved by your family, your friends, the people who knew you before I did.
Watching them laugh with you, tell stories about you, and care about you.
And seeing how much you mean to them, makes me understand a little more, why I do too.

title: Honesty Is Part Of Loving You
script_text:
Loving you doesn't always mean I'll agree with you.
Sometimes I'll be real with you.
I'll tell you what you don't want to hear.
Not to hurt you, not to prove you wrong.
But because I care about you.
And honesty is part of loving you.

title: Proud Of The Things Nobody Claps For
script_text:
I'm proud of you.
And not only when you succeed.
I'm proud of the things nobody claps for.
The days you kept going.
The things you carried quietly.
The times you almost gave up.
You may not always see how far you've come.
But I do.
I always believe in you.

title: Where My Heart Wants To Be
script_text:
I love you.
And I know sometimes your mind will tell you I'm leaving.
That I'm getting tired, that I'll find someone else, that one bad day will be enough.
Whenever your mind starts telling you that, tell me.
I'll hold you close and remind you that I'm still here.
Right where my heart wants to be.

title: You Make Me Smile
script_text:
You make me smile, especially when you don't even know I'm looking.
When you're focused on something, singing badly, talking to yourself.
Doing whatever weird thing you do when you're comfortable.
Those are the moments I like most.
Because you have no idea how much I love that side of you.

title: You Know You Got Me
script_text:
Sometimes I'm annoyed, and I really want to stay annoyed.
Then you say something stupid.
I try not to laugh.
You notice.
And now you're smiling because you know you got me.
So I'm trying even harder not to smile.
I hate when you do that.
But I love that you know just how to.

title: Never Get Too Attached
script_text:
Never get too attached to anyone who doesn't feel the same about you.
Because one-sided expectations can quietly destroy you.
Some people become your whole world, while you remain just a chapter in theirs.
So choose wisely. Choose yourself.

title: You Feel Like A Part Of Me
script_text:
I wasn't looking for you when I met you.
But now, with you, it feels like a part of me always wanted this.
My heart stopped searching for anything else,
the moment it found you.

title: The Only Moment You Can Shape
script_text:
No amount of regret rewrites yesterday.
No amount of worry controls tomorrow.
No guilt can undo what's already happened.
No overthinking has ever brought peace.
The only moment you can shape is this one.
Live it with intention. Make it beautiful.
